source: Same 10 authenticated measurement tiles as R37A, 6 published central occurrences from TF/SF, 4 review-only drifting passports. Distinct scans within one campaign, not independent physical emitter identity.

features.frequency: Use header channel0 + signed df times known path, timestamp from exact scan name plus row start, interval based on half-channel quantization and a half-channel drift uncertainty; evaluate at midpoint of two track centers, max separation 7200s. Linear model is conditional, not an observed frequency outside scan.
features.drift: Least-squares slope on first 16 measured rows in Hz/s, interval using deterministic quantization bound plus residual magnitude. Keep sign only when uncertainty interval excludes zero.
features.modulation: Row-normalized aligned central +/-4Hz cell average, 36s physical blocks, contrast-normalized centered profile, mean absolute successive differences, relative robust variability; only diagnostic, no invented periodicity from short series.
features.harmonics: Report published candidate comb spacings 133.33,15,33.3,128.003 MHz and approximate 2.000004 MHz as residual to nearest positive integer multiple, with diagnostic tolerance 0.01 MHz and n<=1000. No promotion, no selected ratio fitting, no actual harmonic if not supported by independent observation.

tests.pairs: All 45 unordered distinct tiles; primary known central comparisons six within reported central group and nine between reported central groups, remaining candidate pairs explicitly review-only. Same-group does not prove same hardware.
tests.counterfactual: Align different-group measured shape observations to identical frequency and drift metadata; diagnostic test of discriminating shape/modulation against hard collisions, not real labels. Report all 37 cross-group pairs; cannot claim origin validation.
tests.gates: Require all 6 within verified central group retained and 0/9 between known central groups passing joint gate; also report shape-only cross group, all review-only results and artificial collisions. PASS is development retrieval only, no promotion/veto. Real different emitters at same frequency and independently labelled cross-instrument exam remain HOLD.
